name: gigacouch
description: Task shortcuts: the Giga Couch v1 site in apps/site, and the R&D Game Browser app. The root has no dependencies; the site installs its own.

scripts.launch: APP='/Volumes/External/projects/gigacouch-browser/stage/Giga Couch.app'; test -d "$APP" || { echo 'Giga Couch.app is not built. Run pnpm build first.' >&2; exit 1; }; open "$APP"
scripts.launch:windowed: APP='/Volumes/External/projects/gigacouch-browser/stage/Giga Couch.app'; test -d "$APP" || { echo 'Giga Couch.app is not built. Run pnpm build first.' >&2; exit 1; }; GIGACOUCH_WINDOWED=1 "$APP/Contents/MacOS/Giga Couch"
